obligation: The ported tree must exactly equal the result of applying bindings to the pinned upstream commit.
Overrides must contain required must-pin substrings to ensure upstream constraints are not lost.
Any file in the scoped directories not present upstream must be declared as a local-only extra.
The scoped directories must not contain unmigrated Cursor tokens after bindings are applied.
The port sync must refuse to apply text bindings to binary files.
The port sync must fail if any defined binding rule is never applied.
The parity gate must run the port check, contract check, and alias check successfully.
The upstream pin must be recorded in port/upstream.json with a valid commit hash.
The package.json must declare a Bun runtime for the ported scripts under skills/poteto-mode/scripts that require it.
The /skill:<name> invocation must expand arguments into the skill prompt.
A generated per-skill slash shim must forward its arguments to the underlying skill invocation.
A skill name colliding with a reserved command or another skill must throw an error or be excluded.
Skill frontmatter names must be kebab-case and enforce disable-model-invocation while ignoring Cursor-only fields.

name: /pstack
obligation: The /pstack command must act as an alias for /poteto-mode and notify when run without arguments.

name: pstack_decision_log
obligation: The tool must require phase, decision, and why parameters while defaulting path to .pi/decisions.tsv.
The tool must reject paths that do not strictly resolve under the cwd/.pi directory.
The tool must write a TSV header if absent and escape tab and newline characters.
The tool must append a pstack-decision custom entry to the session log.

name: /deslop
obligation: The /deslop command must register exactly once across the modules that own commands.
